Chat

Manage your chat preferences

Chat history

Chats will be saved in your workspace and can be reused. If you disable this, your chats will only be temporary and will not be saved by Libra.

Enable Langfuse tracing

Chat traces help Libra Devs debug issues. However, your chats are visible to Libra and some WK employees. For best support, please enable unless you're entering personal information you'd prefer to keep private. Enabling tracing will reset your current chat and start a new one.

Show Report Response button

Shows the "report response" button on traced responses. Turn this off to hide it (e.g. during sales demos), since end users do not see it.

Show Model Selector
Enable statutes & case law for Libra AI

Allows Libra AI to automatically search German statutes and case law (powered by Wolters Kluwer Online) when relevant. The research selection does not need to be manually activated for this.

Software maintenance contract
§ 1 Software and contracts
(1) The contracting parties agree to maintain the software listed in Annex 1 together with the associated contracts.
(2) The software maintenance contract forms a unit together with the annexes and the contracts for the purchase of the underlying deliverables.
§ 2 Services
(1) The Software House shall provide the following services:
a)Further development: The software company continues to develop the software at its own discretion, in particular to adapt it to new technical requirements.
b)Troubleshooting: The Software House shall support the Client in the analysis and rectification of faults within the agreed service levels.
(2) Software maintenance shall be provided during regular business hours.
